description_en: Queries the number of times a specified table or all tables in a cluster are accessed within a specified date range
description_zh: 查看指定日期内集群下目标表或所有表被访问次数
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-table-access-count --db-cluster-id amv-2ze627uzpkh8a80000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeTableAccessCount

parameters.help_en:
<props="china">The ID of the Enterprise Edition, Basic Edition, or Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.</props>
<props="intl">The ID of the Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.</props>

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454250.html operation to query the IDs of all clusters in a region
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">企业版、基础版或湖仓版集群ID。</props>
<props="intl">湖仓版集群ID。</props>

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454250.html接口查看目标地域下所有集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the table.
If this parameter is left empty, the access frequency data of all tables in the cluster within the specified date range is returned
parameters.help_zh:
目标表名。
若该参数留空，则会返回当前日期内目标集群下所有表的使用频次数据
parameters.name: table_name

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query, in UTC. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ.
Only data within the last 30 days can be queried
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始时间，UTC时间，格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。
仅支持查看30天内的数据
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
Sorts the query results by a specified field. The value is a JSON string. Example: `[{"Field":"TableSchema","Type":"Asc"}]`.
`Field` specifies the field by which to sort. Valid values:
    - `TableSchema`: the name of the database to which the table belongs.
    - `TableName`: the table name.
    - `AccessCount`: the number of times the table is accessed.
`Type` specifies the sort order. Valid values:
    - `Asc`: ascending order.
    - `Desc`: descending order.

If this parameter is not specified, the results are sorted by the database name of the table in ascending order by default
parameters.help_zh:
将查询结果按指定字段进行排序。格式为JOSN字符串，例如`[{"Field":"TableSchema","Type":"Asc"}]`。其中：
`Field`表示排序字段。支持如下取值：
    - `TableSchema`：表所属的数据库名。
    - `TableName`：表名。
    - `AccessCount`：表被访问的次数。
`Type`表示排序方式。支持如下取值：
    - `Asc`：升序排序。
    - `Desc`： 降序排序。

若不设置参数，默认按照目标表所属的数据库升序排列
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be a positive integer that does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值为大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:
10 (default)
30
50
100
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值：
10（默认值）
30
50
100
parameters.name: page_size

AccessCount.description_en: The number of times the table was accessed

InstanceName.description_en: The cluster ID of the cluster to which the table belongs

ReportDate.description_en: The date on which the table was used

TableSchema.description_en: The database to which the table belongs

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
